response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
